test_partition_strategy_enum: test the PartitionStrategy enum values and string parsing for index_split and spatial strategies
test_partition_atoms_index_split: test partition_atoms_index_split to assign atoms to ranks using contiguous index-based splitting across devices
test_partition_atoms_spatial: test partition_atoms_spatial to assign atoms to ranks using Morton Z-order curve for spatial locality
test_spatial_locality: test that spatial partitioning groups nearby atoms into the same rank for better locality
test_balanced_partitioning: test that both index_split and spatial partitioning produce balanced workloads across all ranks
